arxiv-2105-03435.title: ELVES I: Structures of Dwarf Satellites of MW-like Galaxies; Morphology, Scaling Relations, and Intrinsic Shapes Journal: ApJ astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) sep ( Barbary 2016 ) imfit ( Erwin 2015 ) emcee ( Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 )
arxiv-2105-03435.creator: Scott G. Carlsten, Jenny E. Greene, Johnny P. Greco, Rachael L. Beaton, Erin Kado-Fong
arxiv-2105-03435.description: Abstract The structure of a dwarf galaxy is an important probe into the effects of stellar feedback and environment. Using an unprecedented sample of 223 low-mass satellites from the ongoing Exploration of Local VolumE Satellites (ELVES) Survey, we explore the structures of dwarf satellites in the mass range 10 5.5 < M ⋆ < 10 8.5 10^{5.5}<M_{\star}<10^{8.5} M ⊙ .

arxiv-2205-02516.title: Tests of the parametrizations of Fragmentation Functions using data on inclusive pion and kaon production in unpolarized p ​ p pp collisions from the STAR collaboration and at the NICA project.
arxiv-2205-02516.creator: D. Kotlorz, E. Christova, E. Leader
arxiv-2205-02516.description: Abstract The goal of this study is to check which, if any, of the published versions of the pion and kaon fragmentation functions is compatible with the STAR data on semi-inclusive pion and kaon production in proton-proton collisions, and on the basis of this analysis to make reliable predictions for the p T p_{T} spectra of the pions and kaons

arxiv-2211-02384.title: Quasinormal Modes and Love Numbers of Kerr Black Holes from AdS 2 Black Holes
arxiv-2211-02384.creator: A. Riotto
arxiv-2211-02384.description: Abstract We show that the linear perturbations of any spin field in the near-zone limit of the Kerr black hole are identical to those of an AdS 2 black hole which enjoys the same basic properties of the Kerr black hole.

arxiv-2502-01184.title: FragmentNet: Adaptive Graph Fragmentation for Graph-to-Sequence Molecular Representation Learning
arxiv-2502-01184.creator: Ankur Samanta, Rohan Gupta, Aditi Misra, Christian McIntosh Clarke, Jayakumar Rajadas
arxiv-2502-01184.description: Abstract Molecular property prediction uses molecular structure to infer chemical properties. Chemically interpretable representations that capture meaningful intramolecular interactions enhance the usability and effectiveness of these predictions. However, existing methods often rely on atom-based or rule-based fragment tokenization, which can be chemically suboptimal and lack scalability.

arxiv-2502-17239.title: Baichuan-Audio: A Unified Framework for End-to-End Speech Interaction Thanks: Corresponding author.
arxiv-2502-17239.creator: Tianpeng Li Jun Liu Tao Zhang Yuanbo Fang Da Pan Mingrui Wang
arxiv-2502-17239.description: Abstract We introduce Baichuan-Audio, an end-to-end audio large language model that seamlessly integrates audio understanding and generation. It features a text-guided aligned speech generation mechanism, enabling real-time speech interaction with both comprehension and generation capabilities. Baichuan-Audio leverages a pre-trained ASR model, followed by multi-codebook discretization of speech at a frame rate of 12.5 Hz.

arxiv-2505-22243.title: UDuo: Universal Dual Optimization Framework for Online Matching
arxiv-2505-22243.creator: Bin Li, Diwei Liu, Zehong Hu, Jia Jia
arxiv-2505-22243.description: Abstract Online resource allocation under budget constraints critically depends on proper modeling of user arrival dynamics. Classical approaches employ stochastic user arrival models to derive near-optimal solutions through fractional matching formulations of exposed users for downstream allocation tasks. However, this is no longer a reasonable assumption when the environment changes dynamically.

arxiv-2507-17238.title: Coupling of magnetic and lattice collective excitations in the 2D van der Waals antiferromagnet FePS 3
arxiv-2507-17238.creator: Kartik Panda, Itzik Kapon, Dumitru Dumcenco, Dirk van der Marel, Alexey Kuzmenko, Nimrod Bachar
arxiv-2507-17238.description: Abstract We report a comprehensive magneto-optical study of FePS 3 single crystals using temperature-dependent polarized transmission spectroscopy and Faraday rotation measurements. Our data reveal strong in-plane anisotropy of both phonon and magnon excitations. These anisotropies emerge distinctly below the Néel temperature ( T N ≈ 118 ​ K T_{N}\approx 118\penalty\ K ).

pmc-11439004.creator: Pan Zhou, Jian-hui Xiao, Yun Li, Li Zhou, Zhe Deng
pmc-11439004.description: This study addresses the relationship between platelet count and 30-day in-hospital mortality in End-Stage Kidney Disease (ESRD) patients in the intensive care unit (ICU), a topic with limited existing evidence. pmc-11461760.description: BackgroundKRAS mutation is one of the most common driver oncogenes in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), and the most common mutation subtype is G12C. pmc-11491851.title: Decoding and modifying dynamic attentional bias in gaming disorder
pmc-11491851.creator: Taiki Oka, Takatomi Kubo, Nao Kobayashi, Misa Murakami, Toshinori Chiba, Aurelio Cortese
pmc-11491851.description: With the spread of smartphones and computer games, concerns have escalated regarding the rising prevalence of gaming disorder. Patients often display attentional biases, unconsciously turning their attention towards gaming-related stimuli. However, attempts to discover and ameliorate these attentional deficits have yielded inconsistent outcomes, potentially due to the dynamic nature of attentional bias.

pmc-11602790.title: Update on the diagnosis and treatment of CNO in children: a clinician’s perspective
pmc-11602790.creator: Clément Triaille, Jean Jacques De Bruycker, Marie-Claude Miron, Frédéric Lecouvet, Hermann Girschick, Carine Wouters
pmc-11602790.description: Chronic non-bacterial osteomyelitis (CNO) is caused by aseptic inflammation of bones, primarily driven by the innate immune system. CNO may display different clinical presentations (acute vs chronic, uni- vs multifocal) and is accompanied by other inflammatory disorders in up to a third of patients. Once considered a rare disorder, it has become clear that many patients were underdiagnosed.

Long‐term use of the catheter can lead to colonization of microorganisms and biofilm formation, and may develop into bacterial CAUTI.

pmc-12378203.description: Under the “dual-carbon” target and the shift towards a high-quality economy, achieving a decoupling of energy consumption from economic growth is crucial.
